titles.title: Even So, Come / Love Makes Us Strong

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
All of creation, all of the earth
Make straight a highway, a path for the Lord
Jesus is coming soon
Call back the sinner, wake up the saint
Let every nation shout of Your fame
Jesus is coming soon

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Like a bride waiting for her groom
We’ll be a church ready for You
Every heart longing for our King, we sing
Even so, come, Lord Jesus, come

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
There will be justice, all will be new
Your name forever, faithful and true
Jesus is coming soon

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
So we wait, we wait for You
God, we wait, You’re coming soon

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
We will watch, we will pray
We will wait for that day
Lamps are lit, oil is stored
Hearts are burning, bridegroom Lord

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
We are the church, we are the bride
Love makes us strong to lay down our lives

verse.name: o3
verse.lines:
Come bind us together in love while we wait
Bind us together in love

verse.name: o4
verse.lines:
Give me oil in my lamp
Keep me burning, Lord, I pray
Let me be ready for You
Keep me burning 'til that day
